description: Poll the status of a review submitted via submit_admin_approved_review by its internal_review_id (returned as internal_review_id from submit_admin_approved_review step 2). Returns the current status, ref_link (once published), on_chain_review_id (once published), published_at timestamp, and hidden. Status values: pending_publish (queued for on-chain publishing), published (live, ref_link is set), failed (publishing failed; nothing was minted — call submit_admin_approved_review again from step 1 to retry). Call this after submit_admin_approved_review step 2 to learn when publishing completes and to obtain the ref_link. Poll until status is 'published' or 'failed'. hidden is independent of status: a merchant appeal against this review can be upheld later, which sets hidden=true while status stays 'published'. hidden=true means the review's text stops being served in content responses (fetch_review, GET /v1/review*, discovery) — but the review itself remains published and on-chain, and the author keeps the Review Rank reputation it already earned. Stop expecting the content to be served once hidden is true.

chain_id.description: EVM chain id; omit for Base

internal_review_id.description: Internal review ID returned by submit_admin_approved_review step 2

name: get_review_status
